measurement.method: Read actual runtime GLB vertices and cast a 1.25mm XY grid from +Z into press-frame; inspect Blender 5.1.1 front and oblique renders; add temporary opaque diagnostic plane without exporting any model

approximateArc.note: Generated mesh opening is approximately a half ellipse, not a mathematically exact semicircle

material.note: The existing physical bezel masks rectangle corners. The full dial/old needle region must be opaque; do not use a transparent ring-only image. No depth-test override is needed.
